name: Collection catalogue
description: Check and total a collection kept as a CSV catalogue (books, coins, stamps, cards, records, anything) with columns of your own. Check finds missing and inconsistent fields and likely duplicates (normalised title and year, or catalogue number); Want-list compares with a want-list CSV (what you have, miss and hold twice); Summary counts by category, condition and decade; Valuation totals the values YOU wrote by category and condition for an insurance sheet. No value is ever looked up or estimated. The original is never changed.

presets.label: Check catalogue (missing fields, duplicates)
presets.description: Lists rows with a missing title, year, category, condition or number, years and values that are not valid, condition/category spelled two ways, and duplicates, as file(line) findings.

presets.label: Compare with a want-list
presets.description: Type with=WANTLIST.csv in the extra arguments. Shows what you have, what you miss and what you hold twice, matched by catalogue number or by title and year.

presets.label: Summary (category, condition, decade)
presets.description: Item counts by category, by condition and by decade, using the quantity column when there is one.

presets.label: Insurance valuation sheet
presets.description: Totals the values you wrote in the catalogue by category and condition (value times quantity). Rows without a value are listed, not guessed.
